episodes.summary: The Acorn trail booklet cover is accepted and the work item is closed. The emergency grid constraint remains. The flood card is canceled for this review window.
episodes.goal: For Acorn, open the trail booklet work item.
episodes.rationale: Retain the emergency grid because walkers use it to describe their location. The initial instruction sets the map interval to 200 meters.
episodes.outcome: The cover is accepted and the Acorn trail booklet work item is closed. These are user instructions; no deployment or production verification is recorded.
episodes.open_work: At the opening meeting, the booklet was waiting for review. The warden waived the detour walk, and the flooded route was described as ready to open. The flood card was not accepted, was canceled for this review, and there was no time for it in this review window.
